company.name: Zenflow
company.shortDescription: Zenflow is a medical company that gives new hope to men suffering from BPH symptoms.
company.description: Zenflow was founded in 2014 by a team of Stanford University Biodesign Fellows working in collaboration with top global urologists. After witnessing patients' frustration with existing treatment options, the founders made it their mission to find a better solution to this large unmet clinical need.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States

productsAndServices.description: A minimally invasive system for treating urinary symptoms caused by benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). It uses a temporary or implanted device and delivery system to support prostatic urethral patency without tissue removal.
productsAndServices.name: Zenflow Spring® Implant and Delivery System

productsAndServices.description: A single-use cystoscope designed for visualization during urologic procedures, including assessment and procedural guidance in patients with urinary tract conditions.
productsAndServices.name: Zenflow Single-Use Cystoscope

aiResearchSummary.text: Zenflow is engaged in developing systems, devices, and methods for the delivery, deployment, and retrieval of implants into the prostatic urethra, as described in titles such as 'Systems, devices, and methods for the accurate deployment and imaging of an implant,' 'Methods for deployment of an implant,' and 'Systems, devices, and methods for the retrieval of an implant in the prostatic urethra.' These efforts focus on minimally invasive solutions for benign prostatic hyperplasia.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $24,000,000, or 29.45% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $179,999, representing 0.22% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,282,984 to $171,079,860, a 74.94x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 75 (-12 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-12).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include PROCEPT BioRobotics, Urology Surgeons, Northwoods Urology.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
